app-title: Asaɣn n Uslmad n Izwarn n Afrika - Aberra
welcome-sub: Tawwurt i Asnerni n Afrika s Pi Ecosystem
africa-day: (Deg umulli n Wass n Afrika wis 25, Asnas-a n Uslmad n Pi Pioneers-a yebda)
memorial-title: 🕊️ Deg Tmekti n Tayri n Christina Muzheki Manjengwa
memorial-text:
Asaɣn-a n Uslmad-a yefka i ultma-k taɛzizt Christina Muzheki Manjengwa i yeǧan 8 Ɣuct 2026 i yetwamḍel deg 11 Ɣuct deg W ass n Yimeɣras n Zimbabwe.
Tayri-nnek, aselmed-nnek d tezmert-nnek ttedun ad snernint iswi-nneɣ i usnerni n Afrika.
I lebda deg wulawen-nneɣ. S talwit, Ultma.
intro-p1: Pi Network d aqariḍ adigitaal d asenfar n ecosystem amaḍlan i mmu i bna ad cryptocurrency yili d yelhan i yal ass.
intro-p2: Mgal crypto iqbuṛen i ittxaǧen imakinaɣen s watas s idrimen, Pi Network ittaǧǧa i middn n tagnsa ad ttekkin srid seg tilifunat-nsen.
intro-list:
• Bnu tadamsa tadigitaant igemren medden war tila n lbanka
  • Snernit middn n tagnsa deg umaḍal s tɣula n tilifun
  • Rnut asseqdec n tidet s utilities d DApps
  • Adem tjaṛt seg ufgan ɣer ufgan d afas n ifurman
  • Stanford PhDs ay t-igan - Dok Nicolas Kokkalis & Dok Chengdiao Fan
  • Ugar n 60 Imelyan n Izwarn deg umaḍal
ch1-p2: Azwar 2: Sjel s Facebook neɣ Tilifun → Sekcem tangalt: CHIGALEX1 → Awi 1 Pi arraz
ch1-p3: Aɣula n Wassa: Uɣal-d yal 24h ttekki taqiṛect n usem iwakken ad teɣɣaṛeḍ aɣula.
ch1-p4: Tuccḍiwin timatayin i ilaq ad g-nejj:
ch1-list2:
• Ur seqdec ara isem n lekdeb - ilaq ad yemsasa d ID i KYC
  • Ur tesselqeḍ ara aḥricen aṭas - yan yiwen aḥric
  • Sbedd alarm i uɣula yal 24h iwakken ad teḥfeḍeḍ azal
  • Kcem deg teɣrut n laman deffir 3 wussan akked 5 middn yettwakel
ch1-list:
• Snulqed porte-monnaie n Pi s laman
  • Kemmel 2FA
  • Kemmel KYC
  • Heǧǧi i usmatti n Mainnet
security-msg: ⚠️ Laman n porte-monnaie: UR tettaḍuḍ ara 24 n wawalen nni-k! Tarbaɛt n Pi Core UR k-d tettara ara!
ch2-p1: Porte-monnaie nnek n Pi d banka nnek deg Pi Ecosystem. Iṭṭaf iqariden nnek n Pi s laman deg blockchain.
ch2-p2: Mamek a tteggeḍ: Ldi Pi Browser → Wallet → Snuḍleq Wallet → NɣEL 24 wawalen nnek → Ssekles offline deg 2 wadgen amnaɛen.
ch2-p3: Amu Pi: Bḍu tansa nnek tamatayt (tebdu s G...). Azen Pi: Senteḍ tansa n win i d-yettafen, sekcem amḍan, sented.
ch2-list:
• Aru passphrase ɣef kاغeḍ, mačči d capture
  • Sekles deg 2 wadgen amnaɛen yemgaraden (mačči tilifun kan)
  • Ɛreḍ s 1 Pi uqbel ad t-azneḍ amḍan ameqqran
  • Muqel 4 isekkilen imezwura d 4 ineggura n tansa yal tikkelt
ch2a-p1: S tirmit: Ebdu s idrimen imeẓyanen n uṛebbu (1 Pi). Ssenqed 4 isekkilen imezwura d 4 ineggura n tansa msaɛaden. UR tsenteḍ ara passphrase nnek deg site ma yella!
ch2a-p2: Amahil n tudert: Deg uslmad-a, a n-nag demo n tudert n uzan n 1 Pi ɣer uzwar wayeḍ iwakken ad nbennu laman. Mmekti-d: Tijaṛt n Blockchain ur tettwaglal ara!
ch3-p1: Pi Browser am Google Play Store i Pi. DApps d isnasen ibeṭan i useqdec n tidet — aɣ, aslmad, uraren, iɣewwaṛen s Pi.
ch3-list:
• Pi Chain Mall (PCM) - Asuq ameqqran i Pi
  • WorkforcePool - Imahilen i Izwarn
  • CareForPi - Tadra n tdawsa
  • Chigalex1 Hub - Aslmad (Asnas-a)
  • D 100+ n useqdecen nnayeḍ
ch4-p1: Af-d tidukla i qebblen Pi deg umaḍal s umata deg mapofpi.com. Sjeḍ tamsirt nnek tbedduḍ a teqbleḍ Pi i iɣawsa d iɣewwaren.
ch4-p2: Mamek ara tsejleḍ tamsirt nnek: Ddu ɣer mapofpi.com → Qqen s Pi Wallet → Rnu Tamsirt → Rnu tugniwin, adig, ifarisen → Iɣeblan ad k-id afen! Akka ay Afrika ara yewwi deg uqbal n Pi.
ch5-p1: Azal n Umtawa Amaḍlan (GCV) itteǧa asseqdec n tidet. 1 Pi = $314,159 GCV. Azal-a yebna s izwarn iseqdacen Pi deg tjaṛt n tidet.
ch5-p2: Anamek n GCV: GCV mačči d azal n usbeddel. D amussu i uḥudd n azal n Pi s useqdec n Pi s umtawa ameqqran deg ubadil-nneɣ. Mi ara nsseqdec Pi iɣawsa n tidet s GCV, a n-xelq sseqsi d useqdec. Asnerni adamsan i Afrika.
ch6-p1: Ɣer amawal n Doris Yin i usnulfu n useqdec d temɣer n ecosystem. Arzu, lmed, sselmed wiyaḍ — akka ay n snerna Afrika.
ch6-p2: Tamhalt nnek am Izwar n Afrika: Lmed → Ɛreḍ → Sselmed 2 middn → Sen 2 selmaden 2 nnayeḍ. Akka ay n-awweḍ ɣer 1 Imelyan n Yifriqiyen yelmeden! Sader Whitepaper, ɣer, bḍu tussna yal ass.
final-msg: Afrika tesɛa tifrat ad tili yat seg izeɣlan iǧehden deg useqdec n tidet deg Pi Ecosystem. S yiwet Nbennu. S yiwet Nesselmed.
